overview.description: The Pacer Swan SOS Laddered Moderate ETF (LADM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is a fund-of-funds, aiming to diversify the timing of a structured outcome strategy. The ETF itself does not pursue a structured outcome strategy, it is only attempting to provide a benefit by diversifying the timing element of the strategy. LADM was launched on Jun 25, 2026 and is issued by Pacer.
